title: Chat Corrector PT-BR
description: Correct and improve Brazilian Portuguese messages before sending them in Minecraft chat.
body:
# Chat Corrector PT-BR

**Chat Corrector PT-BR** is a client-side Fabric mod that corrects and improves Brazilian Portuguese messages before they are sent in Minecraft chat.

It can fix spelling, accents, cedilha, capitalization, punctuation, and basic grammar using a hybrid correction system with local rules and an online LanguageTool-based API mode.

The goal is simple: type faster, write better, and send cleaner messages without leaving Minecraft.

## Features

- Corrects Brazilian Portuguese chat messages before sending
- Fixes missing accents and cedilha in common words
- Improves capitalization and final punctuation
- Helps with commas and sentence separation
- Supports commands such as `/c`, `/g`, `/l`, `/r`, `/msg`, `/tell`, `/w`, and similar chat commands
- Preserves the command and corrects only the message part
- Includes local correction mode
- Includes online API correction mode
- Includes hybrid mode with local fallback
- In-game configuration screen with `/corrector config`
- Menu language follows the Minecraft language selected by the user
- Client-side only
- No server installation required

## How it works

When you send a chat message, the mod intercepts it on the client, corrects the text, and then sends the corrected version.
